moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio depth-pullback, written here): Card scales 2.2 → 1 about its centre with blur 8 → 0 px and brightness 1.35 → 1, together in 760 ms power2.inOut; it fades in over the first 300 ms of the loop; four corner brackets fade in over 250 ms once it lands. Site exit: fade 300 ms. Params: duration (0.76 s) · scale đầu (2.2) · blur (8 px) · brightness (1.35).
